cards.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Open Model for Apple
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to release Muse Spark Open, an AI model running natively on Apple silicon. The open-weight model enables on-device AI capabilities for Mac users.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Independent Research Access
cards.body: Anthropic has given frontier AI safety researchers at METR full employee-level access to audit its models. METR can now publish independent assessments without Anthropic's approval.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Platform Enables AI-Powered Creation
cards.body: Bluesky expanded its Attie app to let users build websites, games, and interactive experiences using AI. The platform taps into Bluesky's social network audience for distribution.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian announced AI agents will integrate into its vehicles, with details expected at December's AI & Autonomy Day event. The move signals the automaker's push into autonomous capabilities.

cards.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool
cards.body: Google's new Universal Cart tool is now available across Search and Gemini app in the US. The shopping tool streamlines multi-retailer purchases directly from search results.

cards.title: Amazon's Bee Launches Two Personal AI Devices
cards.body: Bee released updated AI wearables and a credit-card-sized recorder starting at $75. The devices summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and shopping.

cards.title: Figma Introduces Agent Features and Code Layers
cards.body: Figma released new features defining how AI agents operate on its design platform. Code layers feature is now available in open beta for all users.

cards.title: Recursive Intelligence Develops AI-Designed Chip Technology
cards.body: Recursive Intelligence is automating chip design using AI that learns and improves from each iteration. The approach aims to solve the AI compute crisis through faster design cycles.

cards.title: Gudea Uses AI to Prevent Social Media Crises
cards.body: Gudea acts as an internet 'storm tracker,' using AI to detect emerging crises before they escalate. The platform helps organizations spot problematic stories and rumors spreading online.

cards.title: YouTube Music Labels AI-Generated Content
cards.body: YouTube Music launched labels to identify AI-generated or AI-assisted music on the platform. Labels appear on player pages to distinguish human and machine-created content.

cards.title: Apate AI Agents Infiltrate Scams for Intelligence
cards.body: Apate.ai sends AI agents undercover to experience fraud schemes firsthand. The unconventional approach gathers fraud intelligence to protect legitimate users.

cards.title: Deezer Offers AI Music Filtering Toggle
cards.body: Deezer will allow users to filter out AI-generated music with a new toggle feature. The rollout is expected by end of 2026.

cards.title: Zenzap Raises $44M for Workplace AI Chat
cards.body: Zenzap secured $44M in funding for its AI chat app designed to replace WhatsApp in enterprise. Major users include Starbucks and Taco Bell.

cards.title: Floqer's AI Agents Automate Sales Research
cards.body: Floqer deploys AI agents to research sales prospects, eliminating manual work for revenue teams. The platform targets the sales and revenue operations market.

cards.title: Amazon Devices Chief Envisions Ambient AI Future
cards.body: Amazon's Panos Panay outlined a vision where ambient AI devices anticipate user needs without commands. The shift moves from app-based to proactive AI interactions.

cards.title: Open Models: Benefits vs. Security Risks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report questioning whether the benefits of open AI models outweigh cybersecurity risks. The debate centers on balancing transparency with protection against potential attacks.

cards.title: AI Labs Buy Data From Failed Startups
cards.body: AI companies are purchasing datasets and codebases from defunct startups to train their models. One founder netted $25,000 selling his startup's digital archives to AI labs.

cards.title: FTC Probes Anthropic and OpenAI
cards.body: The FTC is investigating major AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI. The probe follows political comments dismissing AI-related concerns.

cards.title: YouTube Music Gets AI-Powered Voice Detection
cards.body: YouTube Music is implementing generative AI to label whether content features human singers or synthesized voices. The new feature helps users identify AI-generated vs. human performances.
